source_snapshot.procedure_direct_xlsx: 【Before Test】 1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition. 2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.). 【During Test】 Hardware required: RDIMM with ECC / HDT Software tool: AMD RAS Error Injection Tool 1.1 DRAM settings: a. CPU Common Options → Platform First Error Handling: Enabled b. UMC Common Options → DDR RAS → DRAM Corrected Error Counter Enable: NoLeakMode c. UMC Common Options → DDR RAS → DRAM Corrected Error Counter Start Count: FFFE (Deviate from default setting FFF5) d. UMC Common Options → DDR RAS → Data Poisoning: Auto e. UMC Common Options → DDR RAS → Disable Memory Error Injection: False f. UMC Common Options → DDR RAS → ECC Configuration → DRAM UECC Retry: Disabled g. FCH Common Options → FCH RAS Options → Reset After SyncFlood: Enabled 1.2 MCA settings: a. CPU Common Options → Platform First Error Handling: Enabled b. UMC Common Options → DDR RAS → DRAM Corrected Error Counter Enable: Disabled c. CPU Common Options → MCA Error Thresh Enable: True d. UMC Common Options → MCA Error Thresh Count: FFE (Deviate from default setting FF5) d. UMC Common Options → DDR RAS → Data Poisoning: Auto e. UMC Common Options → DDR RAS → Disable Memory Error Injection: False f. UMC Common Options → DDR RAS → ECC Configuration → DRAM UECC Retry: Disabled g. FCH Common Options → FCH RAS Options → Reset After SyncFlood: Enabled 2. Unlock CPU via HDT. 3. Boot into Ubuntu 20.04/RHEL 9.0 / Windows 2022. 4. Download the AMD RAS Error Injection Tool, then install and open the software. 5. Enter the following commands: sudo ./cmdline_amdraserrorinjectiontest --listvalidumc 6. Implicit correctable error injection, enter command: sudo ./cmdline_amdraserrorinjectiontest --dramecc --errormode 0 --socketdieumc 0:0:3 --setinjectionmode 0 --enablemcapolling 0 --errortype 0 【After Test】 1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders. 2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria_direct_xlsx: 1. For correctable errors, the tool provides a PASS status. 2. If the OS reports the error within a timeout period, the test passed. 3. If the OS does not report the error within a timeout period, the test failed. 4. Follow the AMD RAS Spec to check the dmesg and Error inject report.
source_snapshot.deepseek_direct_xlsx: PARTIAL | -- Memory slot 1~N: inject the DRAM implicit one-shot error on Memory slot 1~N via the AMD RAS Error Injection Tool (after HDT/unlock + the BIOS RAS knobs from the procedure, e.g. Platform First Error Handling=Enabled + per-unit MCA/UMC settings). Agent stages/verifies with sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "dmesg -T 2>&1 | tail -160 | grep -iE 'corrected|uncorrected|mce|EDAC|umc|address.error|parity'; echo __DRAM_implicit_one-shot_error_on_Memory_slot_1~N; ipmitool sel elist 2>&1 | tail -40 2>&1" but the tool injection step itself is interactive/HW-level and needs the user to drive the exact inject command.

test_case.purpose: Verify one-shot implicit correctable DRAM injection for each required physical slot, proving that the approved target generates exactly one attributable CE on the defined trigger and then automatically stops injecting.
required_package: Populated slot to socket/die/UMC/channel/rank map and required target list
Reason for or replacement of hardcoded tuple 0:0:3
AMD tool/spec version/hash/license and errormode 0/setinjectionmode 0/mcapolling 0/errortype 0 semantics
Exact memory access that triggers the implicit event and target address/allocation
Evidence for arm, one CE consumption, no second event and disarm
DRAM-versus-MCA profile, timeout, abort, recovery and restoration
test_case.test_command: Map every required slot to socket/die/UMC and any channel/rank selector supported by the tool; select one BIOS profile; capture baseline counters; arm mode 0 on one approved tuple; perform the exact documented memory access that consumes the injection; show one counter/event delta at the mapped slot; repeat the trigger to prove no second injection; disarm/inspect residual state, verify memory health and restore configuration before another target.
